dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000pk9u](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000pk9u) Magnitude 5.7 earthquake at 48.106 depth occurred on Jan 15 2025 33km SE of Lata. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -10.9571 longitude 165.9879. It impacted 8658 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
